findings.issue: בֹּקֶר is the noun morning; sentence-initial Mañana is the adverb tomorrow.
Hiphil jussive is indicative future dará a conocer; the causative sense remains, the jussive force does not.
Verbless אֲשֶׁר לוֹ is the fragment al que a él, so the relation is not predicated and לוֹ can be read as the recipient of dar a conocer.

notes: Speech frame, Jehová, el santo, both acercará clauses, and en él match the tokens.
